summary: Route tests/'s four hand-rolled `code ?? 1` extractions through exitStatusOf, and scan for a fifth

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

tests: no suite outside the subprocess helper defaults a missing exit status to 1
acceptance: The scan reds on the pre-fix tree naming all four sites; pnpm test green after.
notes: Sites: loop-process-boundary.integration.test.ts:206,230; cliJobVerbs.test.ts:55; build-changelog.test.ts:45. Each types e.code as `number` when a spawn failure gives an errno string and a kill gives undefined, then launders both to 1 — into suites asserting 0/2/69/78. exitStatusOf (tests/helpers/subprocess.ts:280) already refuses both, consumed only by runCliStreams. Scan needs a vacuity pin: assert the scanned file set is populated.
